content: .{@-तपः@} .²1 a sort of blanket (made of the hair of the mountain goat). .²2 the eighth Muhūrta or portion of the day. .²3 a daughterʼs or sisterʼs son. .²4 the sun.

कुतपः .²1 A Brāhmaṇa. .²2 A twice-born man (द्विजन्मन्). .²3 The sun. .²4 Fire. .²5 A guest. .²6 An ox, a bull. .²7 A daughterʼs son. .²8 A sisterʼs son. .²9 Grain. .²10 The eighth Muhūrta of the day; <ls>Mb. 13. 126. 36</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> अह्नो मुहूर्ता विख्याता दश पञ्च च सर्वदा . तत्राष्टमो मुहूर्तो यः स कालः कुतपः स्मृतः .. .²11 A musical instrument. .²12 A time suitable for the performance of sacrifices to the manes. .{@-पम्@} The Kuśa grass.
